observations: Photo 0 shows a countertop microwave oven with a glass door and control panel on the right.
Brand/model text appears on the door area: 'OLISEA... MAKONI' (partially readable).
No clear photo of the grill/heating element, interior condition, or any power-on display/status.

claims.claim: London used microwave working very well
claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show it powered on or any test result.
Photo 0 does not show grill function, grill element condition, or a working test for grill mode.

risks.risk: Microwave may not heat properly (magnetron/diode issue) even if it powers on.
risks.proof: A short video of the microwave running (e.g., 1–2 minutes) with a cup of water heating test and the timer counting down.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven for heating performance (worst case: treat as needing repair/unknown performance).

risks.risk: Grill function may not work (burnt/failed heating element or wiring).
risks.proof: A short video of grill mode running with visible grill heating (or a temperature/heat test) and timer counting down.
risks.if_unproven: Price as microwave-only / grill not working until proven.

risks.risk: Door seal/gasket or latch may be faulty, causing leakage or failure to start.
risks.proof: Photo/clip of the door latch area and a test showing it starts reliably; ideally a door seal close-up.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential door/latch issue (worst case: reduced reliability).

risks.risk: Interior/turntable condition may be poor (stains, missing/warped turntable plate).
risks.proof: Clear photos of the inside cavity, turntable plate, and rollers (if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming average wear and possible missing/weak accessories unless shown.

proof_requests: Power-on video for microwave mode (timer running) plus a simple water heating test result.
Power-on video for grill mode (timer running) showing grill heating.
Close-up photos of the door seal/latch and the inside cavity/turntable plate.
Photo of the model label/specs (full text) and any included accessories (turntable plate, rack).
response.reason: The photos show a microwave oven, but they do not verify that both microwave and grill functions work. Without a power-on test for each mode, the correct worst-case pricing depends on unproven performance.
